evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep never asked about concerns like movers showing up on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer at step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. No mention of cheaper days or date flexibility pricing.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked for the business. Rep confirmed the booking details but never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' The ask was passive: the customer simply accepted the Saturday October 17th date that rep suggested, and no explicit close was made.

top_strength: Nicole used the customer's name (Katie) throughout the call and demonstrated strong patience and empathy when managing a complex multi-stop, multi-truck logistics problem, ultimately securing the booking.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire sales framework (no concerns check, no promises, no probing for details, no pricing framing, no temperature check, no explicit close) because Nicole treated it as a logistics problem-solve rather than a quote call — but since a quote was provided and a booking made, the framework steps should have been integrated to establish value and confidence before the complex logistics discussion.
